description: Convert an HTML document or a URL to a PDF, PNG, JPEG or WEBP file. Returns a temporary download URL (valid ~2 days).

css.description: Extra CSS to inject, as a URL or raw string.

format.description: Output format: pdf (default), png, jpeg or webp.

landscape.description: Landscape orientation instead of portrait (PDF only).

sandbox.description: Generate a free, watermarked document that does not consume credits. Useful for testing.

source.description: A URL (http/https) or a raw HTML string to convert.

use_print.description: Use the print CSS media type instead of screen.

wait_for.description: A JS variable/function or CSS selector to wait for before capturing.

name: convert
